Class AnimatedElement

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.client.AnimatedElement
All Implemented Interfaces:
AnimationTarget, AutoCloseable
public final class AnimatedElement extends Object implements AnimationTarget, AutoCloseable
Independent render/input layer for any authored element: text, icon, button, tab, panel or a complete subtree. Each instance owns its timeline and optional GPU image. Draw local content through render(), and route input through localPoint()/contains(); these invert the same scale/rotation used for drawing. This adapter does not intercept another mod's private painting/input methods automatically.
